roleContext.jobDescription: A snack-food manufacturer runs eleven packaging lines across two plants and is upgrading them in phases. The engineering project manager plans each upgrade around planned shutdowns, coordinates equipment suppliers and installation contractors, manages permits to work and safety documentation during installation, and hands each line back to production after commissioning. Each upgrade is approved through a capital request, and its benefits, such as throughput, downtime or payback, are reported from production data against the baseline in that request. The role reports to the group engineering manager and works with the plant managers, the site safety advisors and the procurement team.

requirements.text: Plans and schedules capital upgrade projects on production lines around planned shutdowns.
Coordinates equipment suppliers and installation contractors, including permits to work and method statements.
Manages commissioning and the handover of upgraded lines to production.
Tracks the capital request through delivery and reports realised benefits (throughput, downtime or payback) against its baseline.
Holds a recognised project management qualification.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Engineering Project Manager, Packaging Lines

## Experience

- Planned the replacement of a vertical form-fill-seal machine and its checkweigher on line 4 at Hollins Snacks, fitting the installation into a nine-day planned shutdown in August 2023.
- Coordinated the equipment supplier and two installation contractors, reviewing their method statements and issuing permits to work together with the plant's safety advisor.
- Ran commissioning with the supplier's engineer, completed the factory and site acceptance test protocols, and handed the line back to the production manager with a signed handover certificate.
- Kept the project budget tracker and reported committed and actual spend against the approved capital request at the monthly capex review.
- Prepared the lessons-learned review for the line 4 project and shared it with the engineering team before the line 6 upgrade began.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the line 4 handover certificate and the site acceptance test summary, listing the test cases, the punch-list items closed before handover and the signatures of the production manager and the supplier's engineer.
